noTestHelp: Start a conversation to try the agent as its owner, or pick a suggested question below.
testIntro: Try the agent as its owner. Nothing here reaches a real customer.
noVisitorHelp: Start a visitor chat to see the widget as a customer would.
widgetNote: Website chat with the real AI. You play the visitor.
alertText: Context, owner and next action are ready on the lead page.
next1Body: When a visitor shares a need and contact details, the agent captures a lead with the whole chat as context.
next2Body: One accountable owner and one next action are proposed for the lead. Nothing sits unowned.
next3Body: The owner agent drafts the follow-up. A human approves, edits or rejects it before anything leaves the company.
emptyGreetingHelp: Ask anything, or tap a suggestion. Nothing here reaches a real customer.
customerEmptyHelp: Play a website visitor. If you share a need and contact details, a lead is captured.
asVisitor: Real AI answers. You play the visitor
takenOverStatus: You handle this conversation. The AI is quiet
takenOverNotice: You took over. The AI stays quiet until you give the conversation back.
